chapter: 解禳通用法、僧道贤愚章、还赛解厄章
chapter_en: General methods of exorcism; the worth of monks and Daoists; redeeming vows and lifting calamity

units.chapter: 搜决神鬼章第七十四·附:解禳通用法之五
units.chapter_en: Chapter 74, appended 5: general methods of exorcism
units.title: 解禳通用法：病人占问鬼神，术人妄判神司、病家听信宰杀，倾家资而病未必愈、又造来生恶业，占卜的人也难逃；按病症请僧道持经、不宰杀——瘟疫合门斋素请戒僧、疟疾设灶神、胎产诵玉枢经、怪病念观音经、冤业梁皇职、亡魂地藏经、火殃诵火德经、精魅请天师或诵真武经、膈噎施食、屠宰索命戒杀放生、妄罚誓愿斋祭勾消或叩城隍回缴、动土告土设坛、覆宗绝嗣改修、侵占祠宇修复

rule.yi: 病人占问是哪路鬼神的时候，术士随口乱判是哪位神司，病家听信了就宰杀牲畜，把有限的家财倾尽，病未必能好，还给来生造下恶业，连占卜的人也难免。所以解禳按病症来，请僧道念经、斋戒，不用宰杀：瘟疫是上帝降下的，全家一起吃素，虔诚地请戒行严的僧人持经，自然消解，或者请童男礼拜也能得吉；疟疾或有鬼邪，依通书的样式设灶神就能送走；胎产是九天圣母管的，请道士诵玉枢经；怪病、倚草附木的妖，请僧人念观音经；冤业相寻，用梁皇忏（原文作「梁皇职」）解；亡魂出现，用地藏经超度；火殃降下，选火闭日或火收日，请道士诵火德经；精魅所临，大的告天师请法，小的诵真武经驱走；得膈噎症的人，布施食物、吃淡口，能超度饿鬼；屠宰索命的，只有戒杀放生才能免；妄罚誓愿、冒犯天曹的，要设斋祭奠，勾消旧账，穷得还不起愿的可以向天曹递疏、叩城隍退回，富家许过猪羊牛的愿，如今穷了可以做粉牲、纸钱纸马，到天库地库勾消也行；动土兴工出了事要告土，按那个方位设坛，没力量的用粉团斋殷太岁；经商、江湖上的诵三官经，也保读书人的功名；持玉皇经、虔诚祝告药师佛求今世的延年；金刚经作来生的福利；求嗣立梓童清坛，婴幼要念大洞尊经；毁平坟墓、社坛的，不是求神能除，只有改修才能解；侮慢神明的要皈依三宝或许能散；侵占祠宇的只有修复，旧庙才得安全。易卦分类的是万物之情，不能全部备写，卜筮通神明之德，可以自己参详。
rule.en: When a sick person divines about which ghost or spirit it is, the diviners wrongly judge the gods and offices at random, the sick household believes them and slaughters animals, exhausting its limited household means; the illness is not necessarily cured, and evil karma is made for the next life, which even the diviner can hardly escape. So exorcism follows the illness, inviting monks and Daoists to recite scriptures and keep fasts, without slaughter: epidemic is sent down by the Supreme Emperor, and the whole household eats vegetarian together and reverently invites a monk who keeps the precepts to recite the scripture, and it dissolves of itself, or boys performing worship can also bring good fortune; malaria, or where there are ghosts and evil, can be sent away by setting up the Kitchen God in the form of the almanac; childbirth is presided over by the Holy Mother of the Nine Heavens, and a Daoist is invited to recite the Yushu Scripture; for strange illnesses and demons that lean on grass and cling to trees, a monk chants the Guanyin Scripture; where grievances and karma pursue each other, the Liang Emperor rite (the text has 'Liang Emperor office') resolves it; where a dead soul appears, the Earth Store Scripture delivers it; if a fire calamity descends, choose a Fire Close day or a Fire Receive day and invite a Daoist to recite the Fire Virtue Scripture; where sprites have come, if great, appeal to the Heavenly Master to request rites, and if small, recite the Zhenwu Scripture to drive them away; one with a choking obstruction of the gullet gives food and keeps a bland mouth, which can deliver the hungry ghosts; where slaughtered animals demand a life, only abstaining from killing and releasing life can avoid it; those who rashly swore oaths and vows and offended the Heavenly Bureau must set a fast and offering to cancel the old debt, and one too poor to redeem the vow can present a memorial to the Heavenly Bureau and kowtow to the City God to return it, and a rich family that vowed pigs, sheep and oxen and is now poor can make flour animals, paper money and paper horses, and cancelling at the Heavenly Treasury and Earthly Treasury will do; when digging and building bring trouble, report to the Earth and set up an altar according to that quarter, and those without means offer flour balls as a fast to Tai Sui Yin; merchants and those on rivers and lakes recite the Three Officials Scripture, which also protects scholars' careers; reciting the Jade Emperor Scripture and reverently praying to the Medicine Buddha seeks long life in this world; the Diamond Sutra makes blessings for the next life; to seek an heir set up a pure altar to Zitong, and for infants recite the Great Cavern Honoured Scripture; where tombs and earth altars have been levelled, praying to the gods cannot remove it, and only rebuilding can resolve it; those who have insulted the gods must take refuge in the Three Jewels and may perhaps be dispersed; for encroaching on a shrine, only restoration, and then the old temple is safe. The hexagrams of the Yi classify the natures of all things and cannot all be written out in full; divination communicates with the virtue of the spirits, and one may examine it for oneself.

zh: 凡人疾病占问鬼神，术人妄判神司，病家听信宰杀，倾有限之家资，
病未必愈，造来生之恶业，卜亦难逃。
且如瘟疫，系上帝之了剌降，虽日时行亦不善而降殃，
但当合门齐素虔请戒僧持通连经，自得消解。或童男礼拜亦可迪吉。
又如虐疾或有鬼邪，依通书之状式设灶神而可遣。
胎产乃九天圣母所持，延道而诵玉枢经可致临盆之废。
怪病或倚草附木之妖，择僧而念观音经，自是弭灾之法。
冤业相寻，梁皇职可以解，除亡魂出现，地藏经乃能超度。
火殃若降，择火闭日或火收日，延道诵火德经，火乍汝矣！
精魅所临，大则告天师而请法，小则诵真武经而驱遣。
症患膈噎者，惟施食淡口，能超饿鬼。
之途屠宰索命者，独戒杀放生可免，旁生之趣，
又若妄罚誓愿，忤犯天曹，须设斋祭旧而勾消。
若贫难酬愿，可将天曹对疏，叩城隍而回缴，
或富家向许猪羊牛愿后，若贫穷可作粉牲钱马，到天库地库除消亦可。
杜绝兴工动作告土。须按其方隅设坛，无力粉圆可斋殷太岁。
商贾江湖诵三官经，而可保士子功名，
持玉皇经而虔祝药师佛祈当世之延年，金刚经作来生之福利。
祷求嗣续，则建梓童清坛保安，婴幼须念大洞尊经，
至如水火不通或拆桥断路而招谴、左右瘫痪或大秤小斗而生灾。
士庶覆宗盖为毁平冢墓军民绝嗣皆因起灭，社坛非求神而可除，惟改修而可解，
若艺侮神明，须皈依三宝或能求散。
浸占祠宇惟修复，故刹方得安全，
易卦类万物之情因不悉备卜筮通神明之德，自可参详。
yi: 凡是人得了病、占问鬼神的，术士随口乱判是哪位神司，病家听信了就宰杀牲畜，把有限的家财都倾尽了，
病未必好，还给来生造下恶业，占卜的人也难逃。
就说瘟疫，这是上帝降下的了剌（此处原文含混），虽然叫时行，也是因为不善才降下灾殃；
只应全家一起吃素，虔诚地请守戒的僧人持通连经，自然消解，或者请童男礼拜也能引来吉祥。
又如疟疾，或者有鬼邪，依通书的样式设灶神就能送走。
胎产是九天圣母管的，请道士诵玉枢经，可以除去临盆的难处（此处文字含混）。
怪病，或者倚草附木的妖，选僧人念观音经，这自然是平息灾祸的办法。
冤业互相寻找，梁皇忏（原文作「梁皇职」）可以解；有亡魂出现，地藏经才能超度。
火灾如果降下，选火闭日或者火收日，请道士诵火德经，（下面「火乍汝矣」原文含混）。
精魅来临，大的要告天师请法，小的诵真武经驱赶。
得膈噎症的，只要布施食物、吃淡口，能超度饿鬼。
屠宰索命的这一路，只有戒杀放生才能免，这是旁生一趣的事。
又如妄罚誓愿、冒犯天曹的，必须设斋祭奠，勾消旧账。
如果穷得难以还愿，可以向天曹递上对疏，叩城隍退回；
或者富家向神许过猪羊牛的愿，后来穷了，可以做粉牲、纸钱纸马，到天库地库勾消也行。
要杜绝动土兴工惹出的事，要向土地报告，必须按那个方位设坛，没有力量的用粉团斋祭殷太岁。
经商的、走江湖的诵三官经，也能保读书人的功名；
持玉皇经，虔诚祝告药师佛，祈求今世延年；金刚经作来生的福利。
祷求有后，就建梓童清坛保平安；婴幼儿必须念大洞尊经。
至于堵塞水火、拆桥断路而招来谴责，左右瘫痪或者大秤小斗而生出灾祸的，（此处原文没有说办法）
士人百姓宗族覆灭，大多是毁平了坟墓；军民绝嗣，都是因为「起灭」（此处含混）；社坛不是求神能除的，只有改修才能解；
如果侮慢神明，必须皈依三宝，或许能求得消散。
侵占祠宇的，只有修复，旧庙才能安全。
易卦分类万物的情状，不能全部写备，卜筮通神明的德，自然可以自己参详。
en: When people fall ill and divine about ghosts and spirits, the diviners wrongly judge the gods and offices at random, the sick household believes them and slaughters animals, exhausting its limited household means,
the illness is not necessarily cured, evil karma is made for the next life, and the diviner too can hardly escape it.
Take epidemic: it is a descent from the Supreme Emperor, the 'liao la' (the text is garbled here), and though called seasonal, it too descends as calamity because of what is not good;

one should have the whole household eat vegetarian together and reverently invite a monk who keeps the precepts to recite the Tonglian Scripture, and it dissolves of itself, or boys performing worship can also lead to good fortune.
Again, malaria, or where there are ghosts and evil: following the forms of the almanac, set up the Kitchen God and it can be sent away.
Childbirth is presided over by the Holy Mother of the Nine Heavens; invite a Daoist to recite the Yushu Scripture, which can remove the trouble of labour (the wording is loose).
For strange illnesses, or the demons that lean on grass and cling to trees, choose a monk to chant the Guanyin Scripture; this is naturally the way to still calamity.
Where grievances and karma pursue each other, the Liang Emperor rite (the text has 'Liang Emperor office') can resolve it; where a dead soul appears, the Earth Store Scripture can deliver it.
If a fire calamity descends, choose a Fire Close day or a Fire Receive day and invite a Daoist to recite the Fire Virtue Scripture (the words that follow, 'huo zha ru yi', are garbled).
Where sprites and spectres have come, if great, appeal to the Heavenly Master to request rites, and if small, recite the Zhenwu Scripture to drive them away.
For one whose illness is a choking obstruction of the gullet, only give food and keep a bland mouth, which can deliver the hungry ghosts.
For the path of slaughter where the victims demand a life, only abstaining from killing and releasing life can avoid it; it is a matter of the animal realm.
Again, those who rashly swear oaths and vows and offend the Heavenly Bureau must set a fast and offering to cancel the old debt.
If too poor to redeem the vow, one may present a memorial to the Heavenly Bureau and kowtow to the City God to return it;

or a rich family that vowed pigs, sheep and oxen to the gods and has since grown poor can make flour animals, paper money and paper horses, and cancelling at the Heavenly Treasury and Earthly Treasury will also do.

To stop the trouble from starting building work and digging, report to the Earth, and one must set up an altar according to that quarter; those without means offer flour balls as a fast to Tai Sui Yin.
Merchants and those on rivers and lakes recite the Three Officials Scripture, which can also protect scholars' careers;
reciting the Jade Emperor Scripture and reverently praying to the Medicine Buddha seeks long life in this world; the Diamond Sutra makes blessings for the next life.
To pray for an heir, one builds a pure altar to Zitong for safety; for infants one must recite the Great Cavern Honoured Scripture.

As for those who block water and fire or demolish bridges and cut roads and so invite reproach, those with paralysis of left and right, or those who use large scales and small measures and so bring on calamity (the text gives no remedy here),

the overturning of a lineage among gentry and commoners is mostly from levelling tombs, and the lack of heirs among soldiers and people is all from 'starting and destroying' (garbled here); an earth altar cannot be removed by praying to the gods, and only rebuilding can resolve it;
if one has insulted the gods, one must take refuge in the Three Jewels and may perhaps seek dispersal.
For encroaching on a shrine, only restoration, and then the old temple is safe.
The hexagrams of the Yi classify the natures of all things and cannot all be written out in full; divination communicates with the virtue of the spirits, and one may examine it for oneself.

note.yi: 这一节是「总论」的第五段（编号「之五」），也是整个搜决神鬼章的收尾：前面教人怎么认是哪路鬼神，这里教人认了以后怎么办——不杀生，按病症请僧道念经斋戒。开头一句话点明立场：术人乱判神司、病家听信宰杀，既花光家产、病未必好、又造来生恶业，连占卜的人也难免。和本章结语「恐人妄断，恒忧好杀而费财」（LY.ILL.EL.43）、易冒「祭祀莫善于解禳，解禳莫善于修身」（LY.ILL.YM.63、YM.64）是同一个态度。文字多处含混，译文里都标了：「了剌降」不成词；「持通连经」的「通连经」不知是哪部经；「虐疾」是「疟疾」（疟疾写作虐疾）；「可致临盆之废」的「废」字意思不明，译文按「可以除去临盆的难处」的大意；「梁皇职」应是「梁皇忏」（梁皇宝忏，超度冤业的忏法），原文写作「职」；「火乍汝矣」不成句，译文只标出；「之途屠宰索命者」的「之途」疑是「六道」之类，前面文字缺失，这里译作「屠宰索命的这一路」；「旁生之趣」是佛家说的「旁生趣」（畜生道）；「殷太岁」按字面译作 Tai Sui Yin；「梓童」「大洞尊经」按字面音译；「至如水火不通…而生灾」一句列了几种招祸的行为，书里没有接着写办法，「起灭」「艺侮」也不成词，译文里都直接标明。「火闭日、火收日」按字面译作「Fire Close day」「Fire Receive day」，应是建除十二神里的闭日、收日，书里没有解释。「易卦类万物之情，因不悉备」是说本书没有把万物的解禳全部写出，读的人可以自己参详。 这一段里神、经、法事的名字，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This is the fifth section of the 'general discourse' (numbered 'five'), and it closes the whole 'searching out ghosts and spirits' chapter: the earlier parts teach how to tell which ghost or spirit it is, and this teaches what to do once one knows: not to kill, but to invite monks and Daoists to recite scriptures and keep fasts according to the illness. The opening sentence states the position: diviners wrongly judging the gods and offices and sick households believing them and slaughtering animals both use up the household's means, may not cure the illness, and make evil karma for the next life, which even the diviner can hardly escape. It is the same attitude as this chapter's closing passage 'fearing people will judge at random, always worrying that they love killing and waste money' (LY.ILL.EL.43) and the Yi Mao's 'of sacrifice none is better than exorcism, and of exorcism none is better than cultivating oneself' (LY.ILL.YM.63, YM.64). The wording is loose in many places, and the translation marks them: 'liao la jiang' is not a word; the 'Tonglian Scripture' is not known to be any particular scripture; 'nue ji' is the sickness 'nue ji' (malaria), written with a variant character; the character 'fei' in 'can bring about the fei of labour' has an unclear sense, and the translation gives the general sense 'can remove the trouble of labour'; 'Liang Emperor office' should be 'Liang Emperor repentance' (the Liang Emperor precious repentance, a rite to deliver karmic grievances), the original writing 'office' for 'repentance'; 'huo zha ru yi' is not a sentence and is only marked; the 'zhi tu' in 'zhi tu of slaughter, demanding life' is probably 'the six paths' or the like with earlier words missing, and is translated as 'the path of slaughter where the victims demand a life'; 'the animal realm' is the Buddhist 'pang sheng qu' (the realm of animals); 'Tai Sui Yin' is rendered literally; 'Zitong' and 'Great Cavern Honoured Scripture' are transliterated literally; the sentence 'as for those who block water and fire ... and bring on calamity' lists several kinds of conduct that call down misfortune but the book does not go on to give a remedy, and 'starting and destroying' and 'yi wu' are not words either, and the translation marks all of these directly. 'Fire Close day' and 'Fire Receive day' are literal, and are probably the Close and Receive days of the twelve day-spirits, which the book does not explain. 'The hexagrams of the Yi classify the natures of all things, and so cannot all be written out' says that this book has not written out the exorcism of all things in full, and the reader may examine it for himself. Names of gods, spirits, scriptures and rites in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; the book does not explain them, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 75: The worth of monks and Daoists
units.title: 请僧道看应爻：以应爻为主、福德为凭；应上子孙（福德）是受戒善士，父母是法术精专，官鬼是神鬼钦服；兄弟是奸欺伪妄多阻误，妻财是贪利好色、非通天之流；子孙临白虎是恶辈，福德带青龙是善人

rule.yi: 请僧接道是为了招请贤者，要看的是应爻上站着什么。以应爻为主，以福德（子孙）为凭。应爻上是子孙（福德），这个僧道确实是受了戒、有行持的善人；父母临着应，法术精深专一；官鬼临着应，神鬼都敬服；兄弟临着应，多奸诈虚伪、常常阻误；妻财临着应，是贪婪图利、好色营财的人，不是能通天彻地的人。子孙临白虎，是恶人，心里容不下凶险；福德带青龙，是善人，有慈善，心里常存德行。占卦只看应爻，就知道休咎。
rule.en: To invite monks and Daoists in order to summon the worthy, look at what stands on the Other line. The Other line is the main line, and Output (the fortune spirit) is the ground. Output on the Other line: he is a good man who has received the precepts and has real conduct; Resource on it: his rites and arts are refined and exclusive; Pressure on it: gods and ghosts admire and submit; Peer on it: crafty, deceitful and false, and often blocking and erring; Wealth on it: a man greedy for profit, lustful and scheming for wealth, not one of those who penetrate heaven and earth. Output on the White Tiger is a wicked man; Output (the fortune spirit) with the Azure Dragon is a good man, compassionate, whose heart always keeps virtue. In divining, look only at the Other line, and one knows good and ill.

yi: 以应爻为主，以福德为凭。
en: The Other line is the main line, and Output (the fortune spirit) is the ground.

yi: 迎请僧人、接待道士是为了招请贤者，
却要看是什么人站在应爻里。
en: In inviting monks and receiving Daoists to summon the worthy,
look instead at who stands on the Other line.

zh: 有念佛行善因果法缘、或祈福寿、或职悔业根，
如修斋设法、如炼度书符，
而僧人有慈惠降龙道士，
yi: 人活在世上，
有念佛行善、因果法缘的，或者祈求福寿的，或者忏悔业根的，
比如修斋设法、炼度书符，
都是想使活着的和亡故的人得利，
免不了要迎接僧道，
而僧人里有慈悲降龙的，道士里
有法灵伏虎的，
都靠宣扬梵语，
礼拜诵经，
必定能扶持纲常、树立纪律，
才可以入圣超凡。
如果请来的不好，
迎接的不是贤人，
就会搅乱坛场，混淆荤素的坛，
亵渎斋醮的筵席，
沾上污秽的积累（此处含混），
这样就没有感应，
白白摆出了诚意。
占卦只看应爻，
就知道休咎。
en: A person living in the world
may have the karmic bonds of reciting the Buddha's name and doing good, or pray for blessing and long life, or repent the roots of karma,
such as holding fasts and setting up rites, refining and delivering, and writing talismans;
all wish to benefit the living and the dead,
and one cannot but invite monks and Daoists;
and among monks there are compassionate ones who subdue dragons, among Daoists
efficacious ones who subdue tigers,
all by proclaiming Sanskrit chants
and reciting scriptures in worship;
they surely can support the norms and establish the code,
and only then can enter the sacred and transcend the ordinary.
If those invited are not good,
and those welcomed are not worthy,
they will disorder the altar grounds and confuse the meat-eating altar,
profane the ritual feast,
and take on accumulated impurity (garbled here);
this has no response,
and one has set out sincerity in vain.
In divining, look only at the Other line,
and one knows good and ill.

yi: 福德在的时候是真的持戒有行，
父母、官鬼居在那里的，法术精通。
en: When Output is present, the precepts are truly kept;
where Resource or Pressure sits, the rites are thoroughly mastered.

yi: 就是说，如果子孙在应爻上，
一定是受过戒的善士，
有行持的真人。
父母临着它的，
必定法术精专。
官鬼临着它的，
必定神鬼都敬服。
en: That is, if Output is on the Other line,
he is surely a good man who has received the precepts,
a true person of conduct.
Where Resource sits on it,
his rites and arts are surely refined and exclusive.
Where Pressure sits on it,
gods and ghosts surely admire and submit.

yi: 兄爻值在这里，大多奸诈虚伪；
财象临在他身上，喜欢牟利经营。
en: Peer sitting here is mostly crafty and false;
the Wealth image sitting on him likes profit and scheming.

zh: 迎真籍道之法力以赞参。
兄弟应值则奸欺而伪妄，
yi: 供奉佛的时候，
靠僧人的慈悲之因，来（此处含混）助成。
迎接真人，靠道士的法力来赞助参与。
兄弟值在应位，就奸诈欺骗、虚伪妄言，
多阻碍失误，废掉更改。
妻财监临这个人，是贪婪图利的，
好色营财，
是卑鄙、（此处含混）荤腥的人，
不是通天彻地的一类。
en: In making offerings to the Buddha,
one relies on the monk's compassionate cause, to [garbled] and help it succeed.
In welcoming the true one, one relies on the Daoist's power of rites to assist the taking part.
If Peer holds the Other position, he is crafty, deceitful and false,
often blocking and erring, and spoiling the change.
If Wealth oversees the man, he is greedy and seeks profit,
lustful and scheming for wealth,
a base man, [garbled] meat and rank food,
not of the kind who penetrate heaven and earth.

yi: 恶辈：子孙临着白虎；
善人：福德带着青龙。
en: A wicked one: Output on the White Tiger;
a good man: Output (the fortune spirit) with the Azure Dragon.

zh: 其心不胜凶险立行匪凡善良。
yi: 子孙就是僧道，
白虎贴着守着，
他的心受不住凶险，举止行为不是寻常的善良。
福德就是子孙，
青龙卫护着，
那人天性有慈善，（此处原文有误）
心里常存德行。
en: Output is the monk or Daoist;
with the White Tiger attached and guarding,
his heart cannot bear danger, and his conduct is not that of the ordinary good.
Output (the fortune spirit) is Output;
with the Azure Dragon protecting,
the man is by nature compassionate (the original has a slip here),
and his heart always keeps virtue.

note.yi: 这一章说的是请僧道做法事时，怎么看请来的这位僧道是贤是愚。章首小标是「以应爻为主，福德为凭」：占的是「所请的僧道」这个人，他站在应爻上，所以看应爻和它上面的六亲、六神。和这本书别的章一样，先是歌诀、再是解说；这里的解说文字多处含混，译文里标出。「职悔业根」按上下文读作「忏悔业根」；「慈惠降龙」「有法灵伏虎」用的是僧道降龙伏虎的典故，只按字面译；「以亲污积」不成句；「乃鄙入蝎荤」按「乃鄙人〔嗜〕荤」的大意译，并标含混；「盗助」「欺人机有慈善」都不成句，译文里保留并标出。「福德在时」的福德就是子孙，所以「子孙乃僧道也」和「福德即子孙也」是一个意思：子孙在这里既是福德、又是僧道本人。 这一段里神、经、法事的名字，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This chapter is about how to tell, when inviting monks and Daoists to perform rites, whether the one invited is worthy or foolish. The chapter's subtitle is 'the Other line is the main line, and Output is the ground': what is divined is the monk or Daoist invited, who stands on the Other line, so one looks at the Other line and the six relations and six spirits on it. As in the book's other chapters, verse comes first and then the commentary; the commentary here is loose in many places, and the translation marks them. 'Zhi hui ye gen' is read as 'repenting the roots of karma' from the context; 'the compassionate ones who subdue dragons' and 'the efficacious ones who subdue tigers' use the tale of monks and Daoists subduing dragons and tigers, and are translated only literally; 'yi qin wu ji' is not a sentence; 'nai bi ru xie hun' is translated in the general sense of 'a base man craving meat', and marked as garbled; 'dao zhu' and 'qi ren ji you ci shan' are not sentences, and the translation keeps them and marks them. The 'fortune spirit' in 'when the fortune spirit is present' is Output, so 'Output is the monk or Daoist' and 'the fortune spirit is Output' mean the same thing: Output here is both the fortune spirit and the monk or Daoist himself. Names of gods, spirits, scriptures and rites in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; the book does not explain them, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 75: The worth of monks and Daoists
units.title: 请僧道法事成不成：官绝则神天不纳、六冲则僧道无缘（六冲不用）；子孙冲破则诵经如诳语、应空则礼忏如虚文、无子则忏礼徒然；官爻主设醮之场、无鬼无因果、官空无德无功；子旺则斋坛功德无亏、福德掌醮功程有力；福动化鬼、官来克世则作福反凶（求亲反疏、求荣反辱）

rule.yi: 法事成不成，要看几个关口：官鬼绝，神天不接受；卦是六冲，僧道没有缘分，所以六冲的卦不用。子孙用神管着自家的事，诵经宣偈要念得琳琅悦耳，如果遇到冲破，就只是白诵、成了谎话；僧道所在的应位是占卜人的用神，金经实偈要诚敬地宣扬，如果被冲，就白念、成了虚文；应爻落空，穿着袈裟礼拜也没有用，没有子孙，忏悔礼拜也是徒然。官爻主设醮的场地，没有鬼就没有因果，官空就没有德也没有功；子孙乘旺，斋坛的功德没有亏欠；福德掌管醮事，主事功有力。设斋修善的时候，福动却变成了鬼，就是想亲近反而疏远了；作福祈恩的时候，官鬼来克世爻，就是求荣反而得辱——都是要人感应、用心与天神相合，怎么可以亵渎而不加谨慎呢。
rule.en: Whether the rite succeeds depends on several points: if the Pressure line is cut off, the gods and heaven do not accept; if the hexagram is a Six-Clash, monks and Daoists have no affinity, so a Six-Clash hexagram is not used. Output as the Subject governs the affairs of my household, and reciting scriptures and proclaiming verses must be delivered in ringing tones; if it meets clash or break, the reciting is in vain and becomes lying words; the Other position of the monk or Daoist is the Subject of the one divining, and the golden scriptures and true verses must be proclaimed with sincerity and reverence; if it is clashed, the reciting is wasted and becomes an empty text; if the Other line is Void, what use is the robe and the bowing, and if there is no Output, penance and prostration are in vain. The Pressure line governs the site of the ritual; with no ghost there is no cause and effect, and with the Pressure line Void there is no virtue and no merit; with Output riding strength, the merit of the fast altar has no deficiency; Output holds the power of the ritual, and the work has strength. In holding a fast and cultivating good, if Output moves and changes into a ghost, then seeking closeness one grows distant; in performing blessing rites and praying for grace, if the Pressure line comes to control the Self, one seeks honour and gets shame instead; all of it asks for response and for the heart to accord with the heavenly gods, so how may one profane it without taking care?

yi: 神和天不接纳，是因为官鬼断绝；
僧道没有缘分，是因为六冲。
en: The gods and heaven do not accept, because the Pressure line is cut off;
monks and Daoists have no affinity, because of the Six-Clash.

zh: 如官爻值缘人徒尔叩天而天不受，
僧有善缘而凡人因无缘法，
盖缘卦值并冲道多缘法，
而斋主为没因缘良为爻生冲激，
yi: 道场是善事，
必须一片诚意才能感通。
如果官爻值在有缘的人上，白白叩天，天也不接受；
僧人有善缘，而凡人因为没有缘法；
大概是卦里值了冲，道多缘法，（此处含混）
而斋主没有因缘，好像是爻生出冲激的缘故，
所以六冲不用。
en: A ritual ground is a good work,
and needs a single sincerity to move the powers.
If the Pressure line meets the affinity person, he kowtows to heaven in vain and heaven does not accept it;
the monk has good affinity, but the ordinary man lacks the destined bond;
it is probably that the hexagram holds a clash, and the Way has many affinities (garbled here),
while the sponsor has no karmic tie, as if from the lines producing clash and agitation,
and so the Six-Clash is not used.

yi: 子孙被破，诵经宣讲就像说谎；
应爻落空，礼忏拜跪就像一阵风。
en: Output broken, reciting scriptures and proclaiming them is like lying;
the Other line Void, penance and prostration are like the wind.

zh: 诵经宣偈全要琳琅讽念，
若逢冲破则徒诵之而为诳语矣！
僧道应位为占主之用神，
yi: 子孙用神管着我家的事，
诵经宣偈全要像琳琅一样清越地念诵，
如果遇上冲破，那就是白诵、成了谎话了！
僧道所在的应位是占卜人的用神，
金经实偈要诚敬地宣扬。
如果遇上被冲，
那就是白念、成了虚文了！
应爻落空，那袈裟礼拜有什么用？
没有子孙，那（此处含混）忏礼也是白费。
en: Output as the Subject governs the affairs of my household;
reciting scriptures and proclaiming verses must be delivered in ringing, jade-like tones;
if it meets clash or break, the reciting is in vain and has become lying words!
The monk's or Daoist's Other position is the Subject of the one divining;
the golden scriptures and true verses are proclaimed with sincerity and reverence.
If it meets being clashed,
the reciting is wasted and becomes an empty text!
If the Other line is Void, what use is the robe and the bowing?
If there is no Output, then the [garbled] penance and prostration are also in vain.

yi: 官鬼落空，设醮没有因果；
子孙旺相，修斋有大功。
en: The ghost Void, holding the ritual has no cause and effect;
Output strong, cultivating the fast has great merit.

yi: 官爻主管设醮的场地，
没有鬼就没有因也没有果，
鬼煞临在斋坛的事上（此处含混）。
官爻落空，
那有什么德、什么功？
子孙乘着旺，
斋坛的功德没有亏欠。
福德掌管醮事，
主管功程有力。
en: The Pressure line governs the site of the ritual;
with no ghost there is no cause and no effect;
the ghost killing sits on the affairs of the fast altar (garbled here).
If the Pressure line is Void,
what virtue is there, what merit?
If Output rides strength,
the merit of the fast altar has no deficiency.
Output holds the power of the ritual,
and governs the work having strength.

yi: 福变成了鬼爻，官鬼克世，
不但作福，反而遭凶。
en: Output changing into a Pressure line, or the Pressure line controlling the Self,
not only no blessing, but misfortune instead.

zh: 谄之而不蒙福媚之而反见遭用人感应，
yi: 设斋修善，
福动却变成鬼，
那就是想亲近反而疏远了！
作福祈求恩典，
官鬼来克世爻，
那就是求荣耀反而受辱了！
谄媚它却得不到福，巴结它反而遭到（此处含混）感应，
用心要与天神相符合，
感通要合于天理的回应，
怎么可以亵渎而不加谨慎呢？
en: In holding a fast and cultivating good,
if Output moves and changes into a ghost,
then seeking closeness one grows distant!
In performing blessing rites and praying for grace,
if the Pressure line comes to control the Self,
one seeks honour and gets shame instead!
flattering it brings no blessing, fawning on it one instead meets [garbled] response;
the heart must accord with the heavenly gods,
and the moving of them must accord with the reply of heavenly principle;
how may one profane it without taking care?

note.yi: 这一节接上一条（LY.ILL.EL.55）：上一条看请来的僧道是贤是愚，这一条看这场法事能不能成。它的判据基本是熟悉的：官鬼是神天的受纳（官绝则神天不纳）、子孙是诵经念偈的功德（子孙被冲破则徒诵）、应爻是僧道本人（应空则礼忏无益）、六冲是缘分散（六冲不用），福动化鬼、官来克世则作福反凶。「六冲」在这里的意思是「缘散」，和别处的用法（六冲卦病易消，LY.ILL.EL.22）不同——这里是说法事不宜遇六冲。「神天不纳因官绝」的「官绝」是官鬼绝。「鹤憋忏礼」的「鹤憋」不成词，译文里标出；「设旧」疑是「设醮」的误写，译作「holding the ritual」；「修齐」是「修斋」；「鬼煞临斋坛之事」不成句，译文标出；「谄之而不蒙福媚之而反见遭用人感应」一句文字散乱，译文只译出能读的部分。这一节的说理是：要人感应、要用心，所以不能亵渎神明而不谨慎。 这一段里神、经、法事的名字，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: This section follows the previous entry (LY.ILL.EL.55): the previous one looks at whether the monk or Daoist invited is worthy or foolish, and this one looks at whether the rite can succeed. Its criteria are mostly familiar: the Pressure line is the acceptance by the gods and heaven (with the Pressure line cut off, the gods and heaven do not accept); Output is the merit of reciting scriptures and verses (with Output clashed or broken the reciting is in vain); the Other line is the monk or Daoist himself (with the Other line Void, penance is of no use); the Six-Clash scatters affinity (the Six-Clash is not used); and with Output moving and changing into a ghost, or the Pressure line controlling the Self, blessing rites bring misfortune instead. 'Six-Clash' here means 'affinity scattered', which differs from its use elsewhere (a Six-Clash hexagram makes an illness easy to dispel, LY.ILL.EL.22): here it says that a rite should not meet the Six-Clash. The 'guan jue' in 'because the Pressure line is cut off' is the Pressure line cut off. 'He bie chan li' contains 'he bie', which is not a word, and the translation marks it; 'she jiu' is probably a slip for 'she jiao' (holding the ritual), and is translated as 'holding the ritual'; 'xiu qi' is 'xiu zhai' (cultivating the fast); 'the ghost killing sits on the affairs of the fast altar' is not a sentence, and the translation marks it; the sentence 'flattering it brings no blessing, fawning on it one instead meets ... response' is scattered in wording, and only the readable part is translated. The reasoning of this section is: one must have response and must have the heart, and so one may not profane the gods without taking care. Names of gods, spirits, scriptures and rites in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; the book does not explain them, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.

units.chapter_en: Chapter 76: Redeeming vows and lifting calamity
units.title: 还赛解厄：以福神为主、用象为凭；因灾酬愿寻福德、凶吉再辨用爻是否得令；用弱忌兴灾未退、忌衰用旺患能消；父母动克子则洪恩浅、财动生官则邪魅招；世旺子强官受制则祭神之后别无妖、赛神后保平安、解厄后无咎

rule.yi: 酬愿还赛、解厄，以福神（子孙）为主，以用象为凭。因为遭了灾要酬愿，就找福德；吉凶还要辨用爻得不得令。用爻弱而忌神兴，灾没有退；忌神衰而用爻旺，病患能消。父母发动克子孙，恩典浅薄承受不住；财爻发动生官鬼，邪魅就招来了。世爻旺、子孙强、官鬼受制，祭神之后就再没有妖祟；世是自己，旺则病必痊愈，子孙是福，强则压住鬼祟——这个强了，别的就必弱，福旺鬼将除，赛神之后保平安，解厄完了没有咎，禳解就吉，请祷就没有殃。
rule.en: In redeeming vows and lifting calamity, Output (the fortune spirit) is the main line and the Subject image is the ground. Because of a calamity one redeems a vow, so look to Output; for ill or good one must still distinguish whether the Subject line has gained or lost the season. With the Subject weak and the Adversary rising, the calamity has not retreated; with the Adversary weak and the Subject strong, the affliction can dissolve. If Resource moves and controls Output, the great grace is shallow and cannot be borne; if Wealth moves and generates Pressure, evil spirits are invited. With the Self strong, Output strong and the Pressure line held in check, after sacrificing to the gods there is no further evil; the Self is me, and if strong the illness will surely be cured; Output is fortune, and if strong it suppresses the ghostly haunting, and where this is strong the rest must be weak: the fortune strong, the ghost is about to be removed; after giving thanks to the gods peace is assured, when lifting the calamity is done there is no blame, and exorcism then is auspicious and petitioning and praying has no misfortune.

yi: 以福神为主，以用象为凭。
en: Output (the fortune spirit) is the main line, and the Subject image is the ground.

yi: 因为灾祸要酬愿，就寻福德；
吉凶还要辨别用爻。
en: For a calamity, redeeming a vow, look to Output;
for ill or good, one must still distinguish the Subject line.

zh: 因罹患而祟鬼为殃则酬谢之。
又当辨用爻之失令得令，
yi: 人的身体有五脏，
天的气有六经，调摄得好的就安，
失和的就生病；
但是染上灾祸而星辰不顺的，
就向它们祈祷。
因为遭了患难而是祟鬼作殃的，就酬谢它。
许下的愿应当还赛，对神有利；
只要子孙这一卦没有凶，
寻福德所在的占爻就吉。
又要分辨用爻是失令还是得令，
才能使占卜的人皱着的眉头舒开。
en: The human body has five viscera,
and the heavens' qi has six channels; those who regulate them well are at peace,
those out of harmony fall ill;
but if one is infected with calamity and the stars are unfavourable,
one prays to them.
If, having met misfortune, a haunting ghost is the calamity, one gives thanks to it.
A vow made should be redeemed, and the thanksgiving benefits the gods;
as long as Output has no ominous sign,
looking to the divined line where Output sits is auspicious.
One must also distinguish whether the Subject line has lost or gained the season,
so as to make the knitted brows of the one divining relax.

yi: 用爻弱而忌神兴，灾还没有退；
忌神衰而用爻旺，病患能消。
en: The Subject weak and the Adversary rising, the calamity has not retreated;
the Adversary weak and the Subject strong, the affliction can dissolve.

yi: 是说我所占的人是用神，
而用神休囚薄弱，
它的形势就危险了！
而所忌的爻在害它，
如果这害又发动兴旺，
那有谁能抵挡呢？
灾祸过失还没有退，
厄患还没有解。
忌神如果衰弱，
病症就可以消除。
用爻如果旺相，
灾病立刻痊愈。
en: It means that the person I divine about is the Subject,
and if the Subject is resting, trapped and weak,
its situation is perilous!
And the line that is feared does harm,
and if this harm moves and rises,
who can resist it?
The calamity and fault have not retreated,
and the affliction has not been resolved.
If the Adversary is weak,
the illness can be dispelled.
If the Subject line is strong,
the illness is cured at once.

yi: 父母兴动克子孙，大恩就浅；
财爻发动生官鬼，邪魅就招来。
en: Resource rising and controlling Output, the great grace is shallow;
Wealth moving and generating Pressure, evil spirits are invited.

yi: 父母发动能克子孙，
纵然有上天的恩典，也薄弱低劣、难以承受。
财爻兴动就生官鬼，
怎么会没有鬼邪张扬作祸呢？
en: If Resource moves and can control Output,
then even if there is heaven's grace, it is thin and poor and hard to receive.
If the Wealth line rises it generates Pressure;
how could there be no blustering of ghosts and evil making misfortune?

yi: 世爻旺、子孙强、官鬼受制，
祭神之后别的再没有妖祟。
en: The Self strong and Output strong, the Pressure line held in check,
after sacrificing to the gods there is no further evil.

yi: 世爻是我，
旺就病一定安然痊愈。
子孙是福，
强就压制鬼祟，
意思是说这个强，其余的必弱，
福旺鬼就将被除去，
赛神之后保平安，
解厄结束的时候没有（青）咎，
禳解就吉，请祷就没有殃。
en: The Self is me;
if strong, the illness will surely be fully cured.
Output is fortune;
if strong it suppresses the ghostly haunting;
the idea being that where this is strong, the rest must be weak:
the fortune strong, the ghost is about to be removed;
after giving thanks to the gods, peace is assured;
when lifting the calamity is done there is no blame ('qing jiu', the first character probably a slip),
exorcism then is auspicious, and petitioning and praying has no misfortune.

note.yi: 章首小标是「以福神为主，用象为凭」——福神就是子孙。这一章说的是「酬愿还赛、解厄」这类事：遭了灾或病去还愿、谢神，怎么看能不能成。这一章的判据是本书常见的一套：子孙（福神）强、官鬼受制，还赛就吉；父母克子孙、财生官，则不吉。「用弱忌兴」「忌衰用旺」和本书前面的用神、忌神读法一致（LY.ILL.EL.22：忌神旺发患多年）；「世旺则病必安痊，子强则压制鬼祟」是把世爻当作自己、子孙当作能压鬼的福。原文「惟子卦无凶，寻福德占爻则吉」的「子卦」按「子孙一卦」译，读法没有把握；「邹眉」是「皱眉」；「无青咎」的「青」字费解，疑是「责」（无责咎），这里保留原字并标出；「洪恩」是大恩（上天的恩典）。这一章没有说「还赛要不要杀牲」，和上一节（LY.ILL.EL.54）的立场并不冲突。 这一段里神、经、法事的名字，书里没有解释，这里按字面译或音译，不作认定。
note.en: The chapter's subtitle is 'Output (the fortune spirit) is the main line and the Subject image is the ground' — the fortune spirit is Output. This chapter is about redeeming vows and giving thanks and lifting calamity: how to tell, when one redeems a vow or thanks the gods after a calamity or illness, whether it will succeed. Its criteria are a set common in this book: with Output (the fortune spirit) strong and the Pressure line held in check, redeeming the vow is auspicious; with Resource controlling Output and Wealth generating Pressure, it is not. 'Subject weak and Adversary rising' and 'Adversary weak and Subject strong' are consistent with the book's earlier reading of the Subject and the Adversary (LY.ILL.EL.22: the Adversary strong and moving makes an affliction of many years); 'the Self strong and the illness will surely be cured, Output strong and it suppresses the ghostly haunting' takes the Self as oneself and Output as the fortune that can press down the ghost. In the original 'as long as Output has no ominous sign, look to the divined line where Output sits', 'zi gua' (translated 'Output') is read as the Output hexagram, and the reading is not certain; 'zou mei' is 'zhou mei' (knitted brows); the 'qing' in 'wu qing jiu' is hard to understand and is probably 'ze' (blame), and here the original character is kept and marked; 'hong en' is great grace (heaven's grace). This chapter does not say whether redeeming a vow calls for slaughter, and this does not conflict with the position of the previous section (LY.ILL.EL.54). Names of gods, spirits, scriptures and rites in this passage are given by transliteration or plain rendering; the book does not explain them, and none is identified here beyond what the book says.
